run_aggregate_failures: run the aggregate_failure_reports module to merge all JSON files from a directory into a single aggregated JSON output file
test_aggregate_failures: test the aggregate_failures function with a directory of JSON failure report files and verify the aggregated output
refactor_aggregate_failures: refactor the aggregate_failures function to support filtering by file pattern or skipping corrupted JSON files
review_aggregate_failures: review the aggregate_failures function and its CLI interface for error handling and edge cases
summarize_aggregate_failures: summarize the aggregate_failures function that combines multiple JSON failure report files into one array
